concept: Taking your time to do something carefully, instead of rushing to finish
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character slows down to build or make something carefully, and it turns out much better than a rushed attempt
exercise.reflection_prompt: What was different about the careful version compared to a rushed one?
exercise.practice: Student makes or builds something small, taking their time, and notices the difference

assessment.success_marker: student can describe a specific difference care made in their own small project
